AMBER FIRST-LIGHT RAKE — rose-gold dawn band hugging the horizon bleeds upward through amber to cool violet at zenith, single low sun-ray cutting across the bloom-meadow at a five-degree angle, long pink shadows trailing every flower stem.

ANVIL THUNDERHEAD GOLDEN SHOULDER — colossal cumulonimbus anvil dominates the upper right, sun-lit bone-white on its leading edge, bruised violet on its shadow flank, distant rain-curtain trailing grey into the bloom-plain below.

DOUBLE-RAINBOW CLEARING — full primary and secondary rainbow arches spanning the entire upper frame, primary bow saturated, secondary softer and reversed, last retreating storm-cloud dark on the left, rain-glistened bloom-carpet shimmering beneath.

HIGH-NOON CUMULUS CASTLES — deep cerulean sky packed with three-dimensional sculpted cumulus towers, crisp dark undersides catching Ansel Adams hard noon light, every cloud reading fully volumetric against the saturated blue above the bloom-field.

AURORA MAGNETIC CURTAIN — green-and-violet aurora bands ripple from horizon to zenith over a high-latitude bloom-tundra, magnetic-field striations shifting in slow waves, soft cold aurora-glow kissing the frost-rimmed wildflower carpet below.

TWILIGHT VENUS GRADIENT — deep-blue-to-indigo post-sunset gradient fills the upper frame, Venus blazing sharp at the color boundary, first stars pricking through at zenith, the bloom-meadow fading into cool violet shadow beneath.

BLOOD-MOON ASCENT — full crimson lunar disk cresting a distant ridgeline against a deep-purple dusk sky, moonrise glow tinting the bloom-carpet in rose-amber, thin clouds shredding across the moon's face in slow motion.

OVERCAST GOD-RAY PIERCING — uniform silver overcast sheet seals the upper frame, a single brilliant fracture in the cloud releasing one volumetric god-ray beam onto a precise midground patch of bloom, surrounding meadow in cool flat shadow.

MAMMATUS DUSK CEILING — rare pendulous mammatus cloud undersides fill the upper frame in rounded grey-pink bubbles, storm just-passed light giving each lobe a sickly apricot glow, eerie textural canopy above the still-wet bloom-carpet.

MIDNIGHT-SUN ARCTIC HAZE — soft pink-and-amber Arctic midnight-sun glow fills the entire upper frame without a true sunset, horizon permanently warm, bloom-tundra bathed in unending golden hour, the sky never darkening to full night.

CRIMSON HORIZON SPLIT — sky divided sharply between a dark storm-shoulder on the left trailing rain and a clear molten-crimson dusk on the right, the hard vertical boundary itself a dramatic wall above the bloom-plain.

LENTICULAR STACK AT DUSK — three stacked UFO-shaped lenticular clouds glowing apricot-to-rose at sunset, hovering motionless above a distant mountain ridge, their smooth undersides reflecting warm light down onto the bloom-pass below.

ALPENGLOW MAGENTA PEAKS — last-light alpenglow blazes the highest snow-peaks magenta-rose against a deepening cobalt sky, valley bloom-meadow already in blue twilight shadow, only the peaks burning in the dying light above.

PINK CIRRUS COMBED SKY — high pink-cirrus streaks brushed diagonally across the upper frame, gradient from warm gold at the bloom-horizon through magenta to cool violet at zenith, no other cloud, pure atmospheric draftsmanship.

SUPERMOON MOUNTAIN SADDLE — oversized full moon rises in the exact saddle between two dark peaks, its near-white disk enormous against a twilight-blue sky, bloom-pass foreground lit in soft silver-white moonwash.

GROUND-FOG SUNRISE TOPS — low ground-fog hugs the bloom-carpet to knee-height while a clear amber-rose dawn sky opens above, distant ridge-tops rising as islands above the mist, individual bloom-heads poking free of the fog layer.

COTTON-CANDY CIRROCUMULUS — horizon-spanning mackerel-sky cirrocumulus fills the upper frame, each small cell individually lit pink-and-gold at sunset, the cumulative texture like fish-scales in coral and amber above the bloom-field.

MOON HALO ICE RING — complete circular lunar halo surrounds the moon in a thin cirrus night sky, ice-crystal refraction creating a perfect silver ring, soft diffuse moonlight washing the bloom-carpet in even cool luminescence below.

DUSK ORANGE-TO-PURPLE GRADIENT — sun just below the bloom-horizon, molten orange band at the base of the sky grading through coral and rose to deep purple at zenith, long warm rake-light casting bloom-shadows across the meadow.

PURPLE LIGHTNING THUNDERHEAD — vast dark-purple thunderhead fills half the upper frame, internal lightning pulse illuminating its interior in pale blue-white, sun escaping beneath its edge casting a theatrical gold rim, blooms silhouetted below.

CLOUD-INVERSION VALLEY LID — thick cloud-inversion layer sits like a white ceiling above a mountain bloom-valley, peaks and ridgelines punching through the cloud top, the bloom-valley floor below bathed in soft diffuse reflected light.

DAWN MIST ALPENGLOW PEAKS — golden-amber first-light sky fills the upper frame, alpenglow touching the highest snow-peaks rose-pink, low mist coiling off the bloom-meadow in slow tendrils, sun still below the visible horizon.

FULL STAR-FIELD MOON ABSENT — deep navy-to-black moonless night sky packed with the full Milky Way core arching across the upper frame, starlight alone washing the bloom-meadow in barely perceptible silver-blue, horizon glowing faint amber at the edge.

STORM-CLEARED COBALT WITH LAST CLOUD — freshly washed deep-cobalt sky after a storm, one dramatic last storm-cloud retreating across the upper-right, sun now free and hard, wet bloom-carpet below hyper-saturated in the clean post-storm light.

DUSK FIRE WITH CONTRAIL CUTS — deep orange-crimson dusk sky crossed by two or three bright jet contrails catching the last sun like white scars, the contrails lit gold while the sky behind them deepens to violet above the bloom-horizon.

ROSE-AMBER FIRST-LIGHT DAWN — horizon-to-zenith blush rising from deep rose at the bloom-line through warm amber to pale gold at zenith, first sun-rays raking low across the meadow, long parallel shadows stretching between the flower-heads

MOLTEN-DUSK CRIMSON GRADIENT — sun sitting one hand above the bloom-horizon, sky burning from molten-orange at the base through coral-crimson to bruised violet at the zenith, long warm rake-light gilding every petal-face

ANVIL THUNDERHEAD PORTRAIT — colossal cumulonimbus anvil occupying the entire upper frame, sun-side blazing white-gold, shadow-side a deep charcoal purple, distant rain-curtain dragging across the far edge of the bloom-plain in grey veils

DOUBLE-RAINBOW CLEARING SKY — fresh post-storm cerulean opening across the upper frame, vivid primary rainbow arching full-span, softer secondary bow sitting just outside it, last retreating storm-cloud dissolving left, rain-glistened petals below

HIGH-NOON CERULEAN CUMULUS CASTLE — deep saturated cerulean sky packed with sculpted white cumulus-towers, every cloud reading three-dimensional with crisp shadow-undersides, hard midday sun pressing bright white light flat across the bloom-carpet
